q: A dining room is meant to feel taller than it is wide. Which wall treatment best supports that visual goal?
n: A deeper gray tone reads as visually heavier and recedes less, drawing the eye upward and reinforcing a sense of height rather than width, per the source document.

q: For a master bedroom where the client wants a warm, intimate, laid-back mood, which lighting color temperature should be used?
n: Warm white light has a lower, amber-leaning color temperature that reads as soft and relaxing, suiting a cozy, intimate bedroom mood better than cooler tones, per the source document.

q: Which item below is NOT typically classified as a piece of furnishing?
n: Skirting is a fixed architectural trim installed along the base of a wall, not a movable furniture piece, unlike an armoire, console, or chaise lounge, per the source document.

q: A homeowner wants the living room floor to look upscale but stay budget-friendly and low-maintenance. Which flooring material best fits that brief?
o: Full slabs of genuine Carrara marble
n: Ceramic tile gives a refined, finished look at a fraction of the cost of real marble or hardwood, and it's simple to clean and maintain, matching the elegant-but-economical, low-upkeep brief, per the source document.

q: Applying basic feng shui principles, which accent would best support good, flowing energy in a bathroom?
o: A Fu Lu Shou figurine set
n: Live plants introduce fresh, growing energy into a space associated with drainage and loss, helping keep the flow of energy positive and active, per the source document.
